sections.title: Loan Signing Specialist
sections.subtitle: Valley Notary Services
sections.narration: One missed signature can delay your closing. If you're an escrow officer, loan officer, or homebuyer in Stanislaus County, you need a mobile notary who understands loan packages and lender timelines. Valley Notary Services specializes in loan signing and real estate closings across Modesto and the Central Valley.
sections.caption: Loan-ready mobile notary · Stanislaus County

sections.title: The Problem
sections.subtitle: Packages, timelines, signer anxiety
sections.narration: Loan packages are large. Deadlines are tight. Signers are nervous. A notary who rushes, misses an initial, or mishandles the return package can push your closing back days. Escrow and title companies need someone dependable — on time, detail-oriented, and easy to reach.
sections.caption: Details matter on closing day

sections.title: What We Handle
sections.subtitle: Purchase · Refinance · HELOC
sections.narration: We notarize purchase loans, refinances, HELOC signings, and escrow packages. We follow lender instructions, guide signers through each document, and ensure initials and signatures are complete before the package goes back. We don't give legal advice — we perform notarial acts in accordance with California law.
sections.caption: Purchase · Refinance · HELOC · Escrow

sections.title: Mobile Across the County
sections.subtitle: Evening appointments available
sections.narration: We're mobile across Modesto, Ceres, Turlock, Salida, Riverbank, Oakdale, and Stanislaus County. We meet signers at home, office, or a convenient location. Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 7 PM, with Saturday by appointment — because closings don't always happen during business hours.
sections.caption: We come to your signer
